response.title: which power stations can run 240 volt appliances from one unit
response.answer:
Several portable power stations can run 240V appliances from a single unit, without connecting two power stations together.

The important distinction is between:

Native 120/240V split-phase output: Best for US appliances such as well pumps, dryers, HVAC equipment, and some EV chargers.

240V-only output: Can power compatible 240V appliances, but may not support appliances that also need a 120V neutral connection.

240V using two units: Some popular power stations require two inverter units paired together. These don't meet your requirement.

For US appliances, I'd focus on models with native 120/240V split-phase output.
